title: Trace System + trace session Commands
description: Implement the complete named-session trace infrastructure: ApiTraceEntry record, TraceWriter (append-only JSONL with Authorization always excluded), TraceSession (sessions.json index), TraceExporter (JSONL → JSON array), passive auto-append in ApiClient, and all five trace session subcommands.
prerequisiteState: Stories 1-5 complete. ApiClient is working. IOutputWriter is wired. No trace infrastructure exists yet.
goal: After trace session start --name my-run, every subsequent api call automatically appends a trace entry to trace.jsonl with Authorization unconditionally excluded. trace session export returns the complete call log as a JSON array. Sessions survive process exits and agent crashes.
scope: Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Trace/ApiTraceEntry.cs as a sealed record with all fields: Seq, Type (=>"api"), Session, Timestamp, DurationMs, Account, Method, BaseUrl, Url, RequestHeaders (Authorization EXCLUDED), RequestBody, ResponseStatus, ResponseHeaders, ResponseBody, Error

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Trace/TraceSession.cs: manages sessions.json at <configDir>/traces/sessions.json; methods: GetActiveSessionAsync, StartSessionAsync(name), CloseSessionAsync(name), RemoveSessionAsync(name), ListSessionsAsync, IncrementEntryCountAsync(name) — uses file locking for concurrent seq safety (see OQ-008); validate session names — allow only [a-zA-Z0-9_.-], max 64 chars, throw INVALID_ARGS if violated (see OQ-006)

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Trace/TraceWriter.cs: AppendApiEntryAsync(ApiTraceEntry); builds <configDir>/traces/<session-name>/trace.jsonl; unconditionally removes 'authorization' key (case-insensitive) from requestHeaders before any serialization; if no active session silently returns without error; if write fails catch and log at Warning — never rethrow to caller

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Trace/TraceExporter.cs: ExportAsync(name, truncateBodyBytes?, typeFilter?) reads trace.jsonl sequentially, applies optional truncation and type filter, returns the entries as a JSON array; throws SESSION_NOT_FOUND (exit 1) if the named session does not exist; export is non-destructive — trace.jsonl is not modified

Integrate TraceWriter into ApiClient.CallAsync: after receiving the API response (success or error), build ApiTraceEntry including BaseUrl and Url fields; call TraceWriter.AppendApiEntryAsync; any trace error must NOT block or throw to the api call result
Create src/ZapiCli/Commands/TraceCommands.cs with StartSessionCommand, ListSessionsCommand, ExportSessionCommand, CloseSessionCommand, RemoveSessionCommand

StartSessionSettings: --name (req); StartSessionCommand.ExecuteAsync calls TraceSession.StartSessionAsync; returns success with session metadata; starting a session when one is active replaces the active pointer (old session preserved)
ListSessionsCommand: returns JSON array of sessions with name, start_time, entry_count, status; exits 0 if no sessions (empty array)
ExportSessionSettings: --name (req), --truncate-body (optional int bytes), --type (optional 'api'|'pex'); ExportSessionCommand.ExecuteAsync calls TraceExporter.ExportAsync
CloseSessionCommand: marks session status 'closed' in sessions.json; JSONL preserved
RemoveSessionCommand: deletes sessions.json entry + trace directory and all files; SESSION_NOT_FOUND if missing
Register all five commands under 'trace session' branch in Program.cs

Unit tests: Authorization header absent from exported entries; session name 'bad/name' → INVALID_ARGS; no active session → api call succeeds, no trace file created; export is non-destructive; --truncate-body truncates output but not JSONL on disk; SESSION_NOT_FOUND for missing export/close/remove
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
trace session start --name test-run creates session entry in sessions.json and empty trace.jsonl
api call after session start appends exactly one entry to trace.jsonl
Exported trace entry does NOT contain 'authorization' key in requestHeaders (unconditional exclusion by TraceWriter)
trace session export --name test-run returns a JSON array on stdout; trace.jsonl is unmodified
trace session export --type api returns only api-type entries
trace session export --truncate-body 100 truncates body fields to 100 bytes in output; JSONL retains full fidelity
trace session close marks status 'closed'; trace.jsonl preserved for export
trace session remove deletes the sessions.json entry and the trace directory
trace session start with invalid name ('bad/name') → INVALID_ARGS, exit 1
api call with no active session succeeds normally; no trace file created; no error
Starting a new session when one is active replaces the active pointer; old session data preserved
TraceWriter failure (e.g. disk full) does NOT fail the api call
trace session export for non-existent session → SESSION_NOT_FOUND, exit 1
ApiTraceEntry includes both BaseUrl and Url fields (from the ADR-0003 requirement to record base_url for multi-product filtering)
contextForAgent: Read ADR-0007 for the always-on trace session design — key decisions: no per-call --trace flag; silent drop when no session active; named sessions; non-destructive export; Authorization always excluded. The Authorization exclusion MUST be in TraceWriter itself (not in ApiClient or the command). TraceWriter failure must NEVER propagate to the caller — api call must always complete. Read OQ-006 for session name validation and OQ-008 for the seq counter file locking approach. Note: unlike cliq-cli, the ApiTraceEntry also records BaseUrl separately from Url, since zapi-cli uses caller-supplied base URLs (ADR-0003).

openItems.defaultAssumption: See OQ-006. Allow [a-zA-Z0-9_.-], max 64 chars. Throw ZapiCliException(INVALID_ARGS, 1) on violation.
See OQ-008. Use a named Mutex scoped to the session name around the read-increment-write cycle on sessions.json. Wait up to 2000ms; if timeout drop the entry silently.
Wrap all TraceWriter calls in try/catch. On failure, log at Warning level via ILogger. Never rethrow. The api call must complete successfully even if trace writing fails.
